description: This file defines the HarTracer class for capturing and exporting HTTP Archive (HAR) data during browser/network activity in Playwright. It manages network request/response events, creates HAR entries, and handles content embedding or attachment, with options for filtering and timing.

classes.name: HarTracer
classes.description: Class for tracing network activity and generating HAR logs during browser sessions.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Initializes event listeners and begins HAR tracing based on provided options.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops tracing, removes event listeners, and compiles the HAR log.

methods.name: flush
methods.description: Waits for all pending network events to complete.
